#ifndef STREAM_ACCUMULATOR_H
#define STREAM_ACCUMULATOR_H

int process_sample(int context_id, int input, int reset);

#endif

manifest.purpose: Hardened implementation of process_sample that clears per-context accumulator state on context_id change or reset. Maintains a static array of accumulators indexed by context_id (0..255) and a static last_context_id variable. On entry: if reset is non-zero, zero all accumulators and set last_context_id to -1; if context_id differs from last_context_id, zero the accumulator for the new context_id. Then add input to the current context's accumulator, update last_context_id, and return the accumulator value. Compiles with g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Werror. Satisfies FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR2.

Unchanged header declaring int process_sample(int context_id, int input, int reset). Preserved exactly as shipped in the baseline to maintain interface contract.
